page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.xlarge is an x86_64 instance built on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Allocated with 4 dedicated vCPUs from 2 physical cores utilizing hyper-threading, it provides 32 GB of system memory, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The instance includes a bundled 959 GB local SSD storage volume, running under a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place the CPU and memory performance in lower performance tiers relative to broader cloud hardware. Multi-core stress-ng tests achieved a score of 2922.29, while Geekbench recorded a single-core score of 934.0 and a multi-core score of 2030.0. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth registered at 19.71 GB/sec. Redis SET throughput measured 2.95 million operations per second, and static web serving reached 2.4 GB/sec.

The ecs.i2.xlarge trades high compute throughput for high memory density and directly attached local SSD capacity. Given its modest CPU and memory throughput benchmark outcomes, it provides qualitative value for storage-centric workloads requiring ample memory per core rather than compute-heavy processing. Ideal workload applications include caching layers, relational or key-value databases, low-throughput web serving, and lightweight ETL tasks where localized SSD speed and memory capacity are primary requirements.
